# Juan Arcila Portfolio

## About
Juan Arcila is a Senior Full-Stack Developer focused on React.js, Next.js, NestJS, Node.js, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL. He builds scalable web applications, APIs, and digital products for remote, hybrid, and relocation opportunities in Europe and Estonia.

## Services and specialties
- Full-Stack development
- Front-end architecture with React and Next.js
- Back-end APIs with NestJS and Node.js
- PostgreSQL and database-driven applications
- Product modernization and web application maintenance
- Remote collaboration and agile delivery

## Availability
Open to work in Europe and Estonia, with immediate availability for remote or hybrid opportunities.
